answer: Require every identity to pass a live, one-time hardware-rooted check-in: the agent must sign a fresh challenge with a unique device key and complete a short, varied task in one sitting, so a cedar grove of copied identities cannot simply echo one answer across accounts. The check repeats at random intervals, like wind reshaping a dune — each pass costs a separate device and a separate live session. A Sybil operator must buy real hardware and staff real sessions for every fake, so fakes cost devices, time, and attention, not just copied text.
